row.name: Sith Fire
row.effect: Ritual creates blue flames (500ft range). Attack: 3d burn (2x 3d on crit). Grab: Quick Contest of Force Skill vs. Target's Will to pull them closer. Incantation: 1d minutes. Maintenance: 3 FP/min.

levels.name: Sith Fire
levels.description: The caster performs a chanted ritual using an altar to create and manipulate unnaturally hot, blue flames. The flames have a long range of 500 feet.
